description: Before signing: simulate one unsigned Base Mainnet (8453) candidate (chain_id/from/to/value/data); inspect call success/revert, top-level destination and L2 fee constraints, Judgment, reason codes and evidence. Free; no API key, wallet or payment. Complete supported EIP-1559 fee_estimation context optionally estimates L1/L2/applicable Operator/Total Network Fee separately; legacy Judgment is unchanged, not automatic PASS. Inspect http_status, response.judgment and response.simulation. After broadcast use verify_transaction. No signing, broadcasting, custody, asset-delta/risk scan or execution guarantee.

fee_estimation.description: Explicit opt-in to a separate versioned network_fee_estimate. Missing transaction fields are never guessed. Legacy cost_estimate, Judgment and L2 constraints remain unchanged.

access_list.description: Only an empty access list is supported by this fee-estimate version.

gas_limit.description: Declared gas limit, 21000–5000000. Original simulation ceiling is unchanged.

nonce.description: Explicit nonce, 0–9007199254740991; not checked against account state.
